content: 2026 standard minimal Python CI on GitHub Actions: actions/checkout, then astral-sh/setup-uv (pin immutable full-version tag, e.g. @v10.0.1 — setup-uv moved to immutable per-version release tags since v8, no more floating major-version tags) with enable-cache: true, then 'uv sync --locked --all-extras --dev' (--locked fails CI if lockfile is stale), then 'uv run ruff check .' + 'uv run ruff format --check .' for lint/format, 'uv run mypy .' (or pyrefly) for type-check, 'uv run pytest' for unit tests. Ruff replaces flake8+black+isort as a single fast Rust-based tool. Optionally matrix across supported Python versions (e.g. 3.12/3.13).
